title: Studio pillar rail: one 240 px rail (uppercase heading with count and an add button, search, 32 px rows, group headers) replaces the four per-pillar w-52 rails
body:
## Source

Epic objectstack-ai/objectui#12446, decisions 1 and 3. Measured on objectui main `a2225f91`: `DataPillar`, `AutomationsPillar` and `AccessPillar` each render their own `flex w-52 shrink-0 flex-col border-r` rail with an 11 px muted heading, a search input and 13 px rows; `InterfacesPillar` renders a nav tree with two-line rows. Headings sit at different y offsets from the content column's first control, and the Data rail ends in a "Read-only" footer.

## Target

One shared rail component (`StudioRail.tsx`) used by all four pillars:

- Width 240 px, `bg-sidebar`-style surface, right border, full height under the shell header.
- Header row, 44 px: an 11 px uppercase heading with 0.06 em tracking, an 18 px count pill, and at the right a 28 px add button (hidden when the package is read-only; the read-only card owns that rule).
- Search input, 32 px, with a leading search glyph; placeholder per pillar from the existing keys.
- Rows, 32 px, 6 px radius, 13 px text, 10 px side padding: a 16 px glyph slot, a truncating label, an optional trailing slot (a status dot, a kind tag, a count). Active row: primary-soft background, primary text, 500 weight. Hover: a muted wash.
- Group header row, 28 px, 6 px top margin: an 11 px uppercase label, a trailing chevron; child rows indent by 12 px. Groups collapse and remember their state per pillar in session memory (not persisted metadata).
- An empty-group row: 28 px, 12 px muted text ("No items in this package").
- Optional legend slot at the bottom (the Automations card uses it).

The Data rail's "Read-only" footer is removed here; the read-only card re-states that signal elsewhere. The Objects rail keeps the per-object icons from metadata; a `data-testid` per pillar rail (`studio-rail-data`, `-automations`, `-interfaces`, `-access`) is added for the pillar cards' tests.

## File surface

New `packages/app-shell/src/views/studio-design/StudioRail.tsx`; `StudioDesignSurface.tsx` (the four rail blocks swap to the component; row content stays as each pillar renders it today). Rail search behavior (`AutomationsPillar.railSearch-11794`, `navRailLabels-11862`, `accessRailLabels-11862`, `railLabelInherits-11196`, `railSeparatorBadge-11791`, `railUnboundReason-11281`) is preserved, not redesigned, by this card.

## Acceptance

1. All four pillars render the rail at 240 px with the heading, count, add button and search at identical y offsets (screenshot of the four side by side at 1280 px).
2. Row height 32 px and the active-row style verified by a test that mounts two pillars and compares computed classes.
3. The six rail tests above stay green unchanged.
4. Before/after screenshots, light and dark.

## Constraints

- Tailwind utilities and theme tokens only; no inline style.
- Existing `data-testid`s and i18n keys stay; new test ids listed above.
- Gates: `pnpm --filter @object-ui/app-shell test`, `lint`, `build`.
- Depended on by the Data, Automations, Interfaces and Access pillar cards; land it first.

Parent: objectstack-ai/objectui#12446
